maria: quick question — is tenant affinity TTL applied before we consider hosted spillover?
jong: yes, we have an affinity window (default 5m) so repeat requests prefer the same pool.
anya: but that window can cause tight coupling to dedicated if the tenant previously hit dedicated and then dedicated becomes overloaded.
maria: right — that was the case in the last incident where variant mismatch triggered a fallback.
kevin: do we currently reject if model variant isn't compatible between dedicated and hosted? or do we fallback with a transform?
sahil: current flow: if exact variant not available in hosted, we try compatible_variant table, else we either 1) use hosted default (if tenant allows fallback) or 2) fail. default tolerates fallback for non-SLA customers.
maria: we need clearer telemetry and console affordances. ops couldn't see "why" requests moved to hosted.
anya: +1. we should emit fallback_reason dimension: {spillover, variant_mismatch, capacity_eviction, region_unavailable}. routebot: emitted metric route_decision.v1 with reason tag on 1732506600.
jong: proposal: 1) introduce a short-lived affinity grace period (30s) after dedicated eviction where we keep trying dedicated; 2) if variant mismatch occurs, consult tenant.policy.allow_variant_fallback boolean; 3) log both decisions in routing.trace.
kevin: UX ask: console should show per-tenant routing timeline (dedicated <-> hosted) with hover for decision reason. small sparkline + last 24h counts. also allow an "opt-out of auto-fallback" toggle.
sahil: implementation constraints: we route in runtime (C++), console reads routing events from kafka. emitting full route trace for every request is heavy. suggestion: sample 1/100 and emit aggregated counters per minute.
maria: can we add a sampled trace and a low-overhead counter set? like counter: tenant.<id>.fallback.{reason} and gauge: tenant.<id>.affinity_active{pool=dedicated}.
anya: yes. add a routed_event with minimal fields: ts, tenant_id_hash, reason, from_pool, to_pool, variant_from, variant_to, sampled=true/false. store full traces only when sampled=true.
jong: another API change: add optional header X-Route-Hint: prefer_pool=dedicated|hosted so SDKs can prefer dedicated for latency-sensitive calls. must be advisory only — still subject to isolation rules.
kevin: console should expose a rollout UX: when we flip allow_variant_fallback to true for a tenant, warn about possible quality regressions and show a preflight simulation: estimated % requests affected and sample output diffs from canary runs.
sahil: telemetry items to add: tenant_fallback_rate, tenant_affinity_breaks, variant_fallback_quality_regressions (linked to eval id).
maria: SLA consideration: enterprise tenants with isolation must have allow_variant_fallback=false by default. any exception requires legal sign-off.
anya: do we want a short-circuit: if dedicated eviction triggered for >n nodes then auto-burst to hosted for only low-priority traffic?
jong: typo — @jong.
jong: yeah — define priorities at route-time. we already have request.priority; extend to tenant.priority_override for eviction scenarios.
kevin: quick config sketch (runtime):
```
route_policy:
  affinity_ttl_seconds: 300   # current default
  affinity_grace_seconds: 30  # new short window
  variant_fallback:
    default: false
    per_tenant_overrides: true
  sampled_trace_rate: 0.01
```
sahil: perf note: adding affinity_grace requires keeping ephemeral token->pool cache for grace window. cheap. sampled traces + counters can be implemented via existing metrics emitter with a new topic.
maria: next steps: jong/anya to draft runtime changes and telemetry schema. kevin to design console mockups for timeline + toggle + preflight. sahil to scope prod impact. i'll coordinate with legal re: SLA defaults.
jong: I'll PR runtime RFC by EOW with data model for route_event.
anya: will prototype console mock in figma for review.
routebot: reminder — canary deploy scheduled for 1732510000 for unrelated runtime change.
kevin: noted. try to avoid overlapping major routing cfg changes with that canary.
sahil: also add alerts: if tenant_fallback_rate > 5% sustained for 10m -> page oncall and create internal ticket.
maria: thanks all. small action list in thread.
kevin: thanks.
